headline: Merck (MRK) Plans Early HIV Pill Licensing Across 129 Countries
summary: Merck (NYSE:MRK) has outlined a global access plan for its investigational once-monthly oral HIV prevention pill, alimatravir. The company is pursuing early voluntary licensing and regional manufacturing across 129 low and middle income countries ahead of Phase 3 completion. New public private partnerships and regulatory engagement aim to prepare health systems for a rapid rollout if the drug is approved.
